第15章 豪门千金（15）-《反派BOSS有毒》

下一章

虽然南宫景警告了那些人，但是依旧有风声传了出去，当时在场的人那么多，还有请来的服务人员，哪里查得到是谁泄露出去的。

苏衣衣之前就有点不好的名声，这次在加上这件事，苏衣衣名声是彻底毁了。

南宫景找上门时笙已经预料到了，只是她没想到南宫景会绑架她。

“南宫景，我看你真的是疯了。”时笙安静的坐在两个彪形大汉中间，神色淡然，微微上翘的唇角，似乎有几分讥讽。

南宫景坐在她对面，面容沧桑，像是老了好几岁，他没有从对面的女人身上看到害怕，惊慌，恐惧，更没有对他的爱意。

他只看到了平静。

南宫景心底一阵暴躁，许乘月不该是这样的。

“衣衣受的罪，我会让你千百倍的还回来。”南宫景说完这句话就有些狼狈的移开了视线。

他讨厌对面那个女人一脸平静，不把自己放在眼里的样子，他要她跪在地上求饶，跪着给衣衣道歉。

“关我什么事？”妈的智障！

“你敢说不是你指使的？”他已经查到下药的人是谁，但是他不相信这件事和许乘月没有关系，一定她在背后指使的，只有她才会那么恨衣衣，恨不得毁了她。

时笙推了推旁边的彪形大汉，给自己留出更多的空间，换了个舒服的姿势坐着，“如果是我来做这件事，苏衣衣何止是受那点罪。”

原主曾经又做错了什么，苏衣衣明知道那饮料里被动了手脚，还换给原主。最后还将南宫景叫来，她不过是把她曾经对原主做的还给她，她还没动手。

“你怎么那么恶毒。”南宫景猛的转头过，满身的阴戾。

“谢谢夸奖，你不是第一个这么说我的。”

“不可理喻。”

不可理喻到底是谁啊！男主大人你这脑回路也特么的是挺清奇的。

老子现在不和你说，有你哭的时候。

也不知是不是因为她没什么攻击力，南宫景并没有绑她，车子开了许久，到后面越来越颠簸，最后直接进了山。

车子停在山里的一处别墅前，时笙被粗鲁的扯出来，南宫景让人将她关在了二楼的一个房间，这次倒是把她给绑上了。

【宿主，你为什么一再挑衅南宫景。】

时笙扭着身子，麻溜的给自己松了绑。

Although Nangong Jing warned those people, the news still spread. There were so many people present at the time, as well as the service personnel invited, who could find out who leaked it.

Su Yiyi had a bad reputation before, but this time with this incident, Su Yiyi's reputation was completely ruined.

Sheng had already expected Nangong Jing to come to her door, but she didn't expect Nangong Jing to kidnap her.

"Nangong Jing, I think you are really crazy." Shi Sheng sat quietly between the two burly men, his expression indifferent, and the corners of his slightly upturned lips seemed a bit sarcastic.

Nangong Jing sat opposite her, his face changed, as if he had aged several years. He saw no fear, panic, fear, and no love for him from the woman opposite.

He saw only peace.

Nangong Jing felt irritable in his heart, Xu Chengyue shouldn't be like this.

"I will pay you back a thousand times for the pain Yiyi suffered." After Nangong Jing said this, he looked away in embarrassment.

He hated the way the woman opposite looked calm and didn't take him seriously. He wanted her to kneel on the ground to beg for mercy and apologize to Yiyi on her knees.

"What does it have to do with me?" Damn you, you're retarded!

"Do you dare to say that you didn't instigate it?" He had already found out who was the person who drugged him, but he didn't believe that this incident had nothing to do with Xu Chengyue. She must have instigated it behind his back. Only she would hate Yiyi so much and wish to destroy her.

Shi Sheng pushed the burly man next to him to give himself more space, and sat in a comfortable position, "If I were to do this, Su Yiyi would not have to suffer more than that."

The original owner had done something wrong again, and Su Yiyi gave it to the original owner despite knowing that something had been manipulated in the drink.Finally, Nangong Jing was called over. She just wanted to return what she had done to the original owner, and she hadn't done anything yet.

"Why are you so vicious?" Nangong Jing turned his head sharply, his whole body full of evil.

"Thank you for the compliment. You're not the first to say that about me."

"Incomprehensible."

It’s unreasonable who it is!Sir, your brain circuit is very strange.

If I don’t tell you now, there will be times when you cry.

I don't know if it was because she had no offensive power, but Nangong Jing didn't tie her up. The car drove for a long time, and became more and more bumpy in the back, and finally went directly into the mountain.

The car stopped in front of a villa in the mountains, and Shi Sheng was roughly pulled out. Nangong Jing had her locked in a room on the second floor, but this time he tied her up.

[Host, why do you repeatedly provoke Nangong Jing.】

Shi Sheng twisted around and untied himself smoothly.
